en: A black-and-white image depicts a modernist-style building complex in a flat, arid landscape. The architecture features clean lines, rectangular forms, and minimal ornamentation, with some arches and a prominent square tower with a smokestack, suggesting industrial or institutional purpose. The foreground is barren, with sparse, young trees staked around. There is no visible signage. The sky is partly cloudy, adding to the dramatic atmosphere of the scene.
